headline: Care Home Supervisor, RN
summary: Registered nurse and care home supervisor with ten years in elderly and end-of-life care. I run the daily care of 40 residents in a home for older adults, lead a team of 18 caregivers and nursing aides, and make sure each resident's care plan fits their abilities, wishes and health. I train staff in safe medication, dementia care and palliative care.
highlights: Cut falls among residents by 40% in a year with personalised mobility plans and night checks.
Introduced a palliative care pathway with the visiting physician so residents can spend their last days at the home.
Trained all caregivers in medication safety; no serious medication errors in three years.
